description: Great Salt Lake Basin Reservoir Storage is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Tarboton, David (deposited on HydroShare). This resource aggregates data on the reservoirs and time series of reservoir storage within the Great Salt Lake Basin. It has been assembled by combining information from the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the United States Bureau of Reclamation (USBR). Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2024-01-02 and last updated 2026-03-14; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
